sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Sick headache. Rush of blood with vanish-
ing of sight. Sensation as if brain was contracting and
head became smaller. Tightness in forehead, with
wrinkles in skin. Eyes dry, burn. Myopia.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Vertigo during and after meals; hunger
and feeling of emptiness after meals. Dyspepsia, with
much distention of the stomach. Cramps and colic
after supper and during night, with swelling of abdo-
men and constipation. Dysphagia for liquids.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
~ Diarrhoea ; cj^'ccn, frothy ivater, followed by
anal burning, forcibly evacuated zvithout pain. Consti-
potion, with gouty acidity. "^Hjemorrhoids, with hypo-
chondriasis. Rectum constricted.

' Sleep. — Insomnia.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Nymphomania, Menses too profuse, pre-
mature, and too long.
